notes.title: Wanderlust: Rebirth Patch Notes - 3.08 & 3.09 [Steam]
notes.content:
We implemented a new matchmaking system which should allow players to now host without port-forwarding. The downside? No private games (at least not until we figure out a way to do them), until then, it should be much much easier to play online with other players.

[b]PATCH 3.08[/b]
[list]
    [*] All new matchmaking system
    [*] Steam Networking API integration (no more port-forwarding req.)
[/list]

[EDIT]:
[b]PATCH 3.09[/b]
[list]
    [*] Added private lobby functionality
    [*] Fixed a bug with joining PvP games
    [*] Fixed a bug with Ice Wall
[/list]

Enjoy!
-Yeti Trunk

notes.title: Wanderlust: Rebirth Patch Notes - 3.06
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH 3.06[/h1][list][*] Added a multipurpose Announcement Window at the start of the game.
[*] Added pre-chapter Tips Screen for Normal Mode : to help players improve their chapter scores.
[*] Added a short-term immunity (to statuses) after they affect your character.
[*] The Chapter 5 Boss can now be damaged slightly while armored (instead of invulnerable).
[*] Updated some maps and upgraded the cavern tileset (seen below).
[*] Added foreground (roof tiles) to indoor maps (seen below).
[/list]
